classification.difficultyReason: Substitute the side 2x into 6s² and square the bracket.

content.prompt: What would be the formula for the surface area of a cube with side length $2x$?

answer.worked:
The cube has six square faces, each with area $(2x)^2$.
$$\begin{align*}SA&=6\times(2x)^2\\SA&=6\times4x^2\\SA&=24x^2\end{align*}$$
